column1: # docs/lineage-paper-dates.tsv — arXiv id -> publication date, for the README's recency claim.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the arXiv ID stem does NOT track publication date (2607.09691 was
# published 2026-06-19), so counting IDs overstates recency. readmedriftcheck.sh arm (H)
# joins this against docs/LINEAGE.md's own 2026 rows and re-derives the README's counts.
# Adding a 2026 paper to LINEAGE without adding its date here FAILS arm (H2) by design.
# Dates from the arXiv API <published> field, fetched 2026-09-08.
